author: scale_engineering

coverage: Actual SQLite original pending query as oracle across 401 keys/multiple kinds, duplicates, IN batches, holes/nonexistent exclusions, B=0/1/2/8/40/MAX and alternative admitted subsets
File-row replacement/removal/reopen through original APIs with read pool1; this is not a physical database-swap or full Indexer prepare execution
Explicit over-budget fallback branch and remaining overflow witness
controls_static_review.format_check: author-reported rustfmt1.95 pass; not repeated by this reviewer

limitations: Static nonauthor review only, no Cargo compilation or product execution. New Rust and existing integration/regression gates must actually run before execution acceptance.
This removes redundant tail lookup only; repeated-prefix and per-resume scan asymptotics remain. No speedup, whole-build complexity improvement, 100k feasibility or deadline compliance claimed.
Original G matrix continues with its actual source; this change does not retroactively modify or certify those records.
All native deadlines, capacity budgets, five scales, N30/150 shards/1500 measurements and original task dependencies remain unchanged; no TODO closure.
required_existing_validation_commands: original workspace Clippy and format checks

semantic_review.completed_and_excluded: Initial units/removals added before window lookup, old completed set exact; post-window completion extension is only promoted. Additional root candidates use a clone so mutating additional cannot change witness. Nonpromotable persisted dependents remain conservatively pending.
semantic_review.fallback: If future closure admits more than B paths, return None and run original pending SQL; never certify an exhausted truncated witness.
semantic_review.scope: Surface-dependent queries, closure budgets/rounds, epoch fences, durable state schema, per-prepare file scans and all source/validation acceptance thresholds unchanged. No persistent prefix/cache/index or SQL modification.
semantic_review.snapshot_boundary: Invocation-local Vec only, no read lease or transaction retained and no state survives next prepare. This is not a cross-statement SQLite snapshot. Concurrent supported index writes/rebuilds remain subject to existing prepared_index_epoch commit fence; next prepare queries afresh.
semantic_review.window_proof: Let U be initial dependent paths after old completed exclusions. W is its sorted distinct first B+1 window, bounded by the original helper. This prepare adds only closure.promoted to completed after W, at most B unique files. If |U|>B, at least one member of W remains uncompleted. If W is exhausted, U therefore fitted W and no dependency remains. New pending equals the original limit0 query for unchanged index facts.
semantic_review.work_accounting: Only initial actual SQL work merged on normal path; fallback merges actual tail SQL. No invented query counter or cache-hit work. Saves one helper invocation, potentially multiple kind/key-batch SQL statements.
